create_gym_env: create a Gym environment instance with a specified env_name and optional max_steps parameter
make_gym_env: build a gym.Env from the Gym class using make with optional MiniGrid wrapper support
preprocess_observation: convert a numpy observation array into FeatureData using the obs_preprocessor method
preprocess_serving_obs: transform a 1D Box observation into obs and presence tensors via serving_obs_preprocessor
review_gym_class: review the Gym class and its make, obs_preprocessor, and serving_obs_preprocessor methods
